labs.error: the step's own readiness gate never passed.

PASS.label: Passing
PASS.note: Every step ran and asserted clean.

FAIL.label: Failing
FAIL.note: A step did not produce what it should. This is the only verdict that is a claim about the lab's content.

STALE-PUBLISH.label: Serving an older version
STALE-PUBLISH.detail: the lab is published and runs, but O'Reilly serves an older copy than the repository
STALE-PUBLISH.note: The lab IS published and learners can run it. What O'Reilly serves is an older copy than the repository: it passed while the two matched, the repository has moved on since, and the lab has not rebuilt. That is why it can have a Last passed date.

VERSION-MISMATCH.label: Too old to test
VERSION-MISMATCH.detail: the published copy predates a change the test depends on, so no step ran
VERSION-MISMATCH.note: The published copy predates a change the test depends on, so it was not run at all. This says nothing about whether the lab works - learners may well be fine. It becomes testable again as soon as the lab republishes.

NO-ACCESS.label: Lab will not open (403)
NO-ACCESS.detail: the account cannot open this lab: 403 Forbidden, No Access
NO-ACCESS.note: O'Reilly refuses to open this lab for this account at all. The lab is switched off on their side, so nothing in the repository can change it.

UNPUBLISHED.label: Address returns 404
UNPUBLISHED.detail: the public URL returns 404; the lab appears to be unpublished
UNPUBLISHED.note: Nothing is served at the lab's address right now. It may never have been published, or it may be published and temporarily not served - the two look identical from outside. Retried on every sweep.

UNTESTABLE.label: Cannot be asserted
UNTESTABLE.detail: no published URL: the usage spreadsheet does not list this lab as Live, so nothing ran
UNTESTABLE.note: Nothing in this lab can be checked automatically.

READY-TIMEOUT.label: Lab fails to initialize
READY-TIMEOUT.detail: the lab rendered but the harness never confirmed a settled shell prompt
READY-TIMEOUT.note: The lab DID open and a terminal appeared, but its environment never finished starting on any of five attempts, so no step was reached. Usually transient: the same lab starts normally on a retry.

CLUSTER-LOST.label: Cluster went away
CLUSTER-LOST.detail: the instance lost its control plane mid-run
CLUSTER-LOST.note: The lab cluster disappeared part way through the run.

NO-INSTANCE.label: No lab instance
NO-INSTANCE.detail: five instances failed to provision; no step ran
NO-INSTANCE.note: The platform had no instance to hand out.
